title: Kohler Artifacts Column Bathroom Faucet Spout, Polished Chrome (72760-CP)

comparisons.notes: Same model K-72760-CP spout only, polished chrome; listed in stock

writeup: Kohler's Artifacts widespread bathroom faucet spout with the Victorian column design (72760-CP, polished chrome) is new on Woot for $325.99. It includes the spout with aerator and a metal pop-up drain, but handles are sold separately. Lowe's and SupplyHouse both list this exact spout at $657.07. Only 1 was showing on Woot.
